items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, the bass player's name was Wood Wilson and the guitar player was Tuck Wilson, T-u-c-k.

ctx.x: Yeah, the bass player's name was Wood Wilson and the guitar player was Tuck Wilson, T-u-c-k. They were twin brothers and they were constantly writing my dad, "Come on out, because it's good out here." So, when we came to California, they had the house next to his house all readied for rental purposes and we rented all except one room in the house, which the fellow that owned the house remained in and stayed in and we rented the rest of the house.
We lived there for two or three years next door to this friend of my dad's until we got a little bit bigger house, where we could stretch out a little bit more about a block away.
